contract:
Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::placeOrder(): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentOrderProduct<>null
	postcondition:
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::REQUESTED and
		result = true and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.Amount = self.CurrentOrderProduct.Amount@pre+self.CurrentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->sumBy(e: OrderEntry|e.SubAmount)
}
